observability.OBSERVABLE: a preregistered gate passes AND all sensitivities pass on at least one date (none so far)
observability.MARGINAL: primary gate passes on a date but >= 1 preregistered sensitivity fails
observability.UNOBSERVABLE: every assessed date fails the gate (insufficient valid interior water)
observability.UNKNOWN: observations exist but water identity is inconsistent, or the reach was never assessed at a finer scale

rules.note: Labels prioritise where measurements are missing relative to modelled exposure; they are not pollution-risk scores.
